pages.text: The $(thing)Soil Lab$() is a bench of glassware and reagents. In the field the probe can only tell you how the soil feels, how wet it is and its rough pH.

$(thing)Sneak and right-click$() soil or farmland with the probe to take a $(thing)Soil Sample$(). Use the sample on the lab; after twenty seconds, right-click the lab to collect a written $(thing)Soil Test Report$().

The report has every measurement, the date and place the sample was taken, and advice: how much lime to add, which nutrients are short and what supplies them. Each probe use wears the probe a little; it lasts 63 uses.
